stage: G6 checked live attachment views with immutable resource images
change: Explicit synchronous views only for packed, non-swizzled, aligned linear VRAM attachments; full DMA read permissions and bounds checked each time.
Padded, swizzled, unaligned and system-memory paths retain copied reads.
Exact comparison of fresh bytes remains mandatory. Unchanged data retains the previous immutable image; modified VRAM is copied before retention, so CPU writes cannot change the comparison baseline.
validation: State regressions verify default snapshot ownership, explicit view ownership, read denial, DMA limit, padded and unaligned fallbacks.
Resource regressions verify CPU writes leave cached images unchanged, changed data reuploads and repeated identical views emit no upload.
Complete real WebGPU blend history, aliases, CPU-write ordering, textures, depth/query and snapshot regressions pass.
